evals.prompt: My Temujira credentials are configured. Give me a tmj command sequence to find my tasks with the review tag in workspace ENG, inspect dependencies, work one task, leave a completion note, and mark it Done. Use machine-readable output.
evals.expected_output: Uses task list with workspace, assignee me, tag review, task get, task links, comment add, and task move with --status and explicit --json. Verifies the resulting task state.
assertions: Uses explicit --json for machine-readable reads and mutations.
Uses task move <task> --status Done rather than a positional status.
Uses task filters rather than retired queue commands.
Fetches blocked_by tasks and inspects their state before starting dependent work.

evals.prompt: In workspace ENG, replace the Priority select field options with urgent and normal, then delete the QA status and move any affected tasks to Done. I do not know any entity IDs. Give a safe tmj plan, not just the final write commands.
evals.expected_output: Lists fields and statuses as JSON, resolves exact IDs, verifies scope, treats option update as full replacement, deletes status with --move-to using a same-workspace Done status ID, and verifies afterward without inventing unsupported flags.
assertions: Reads fields and statuses before mutation and captures IDs from JSON.
States that field update --options replaces the complete option set.
Uses status delete <qa-id> --move-to <done-id> with IDs from ENG.
Does not invent field delete --force or another unsupported command.

evals.prompt: Without an interactive TTY, onboard a passwordless Temujira agent called Build Bot, explain how to hand over its shared credential safely, then show how that agent should notify ada@example.com in a comment on ENG-42 and watch for replies.
evals.expected_output: Uses user create --agent --with-key --json without --quiet, warns the token is shown once, recommends TEMUJIRA_URL/TEMUJIRA_API_KEY, and uses both visible mention text and --mention for the comment.
assertions: Creates a passwordless account with user create --agent --with-key --json.
Does not use --quiet when the one-time token must be captured.
Recommends environment API-key authentication without logging the secret.
Uses comment add with both visible @Ada text and --mention ada@example.com.
Uses inbox watch --json for replies and explains cursor resume without automatic mark-read.
